case.state: This is the place, Cebe. Keep an eye out for me, won't you?
Okay... This is it. The place. Keep an eye out for me, Cebe.
Time for a new game. I'm Saria. Good to meet everyone...
Not that I mind pointy ears... but I didn't come all this way to play with people I could find at any inn in Hyrule Field...
Looks like we'll all be hearing just fine tonight, huh?
I've played plenty of card games, but to~background.time~'s wager is just what I was looking for...
Come on, come on! Let's get this started, already!
Don't worry about me. I've got more experience under my belt than you can shake a Deku stick at.
~Cards.text~.
~Cards.text~, dealer.
~Cards.text~, please.
Nothing I haven't seen before. ~Cards.text~.
Awww, no extra cards for a cute, innocent Kokiri like me?
Don't worry. I won't bite. Not when I have these cards in hand.
Cards are fun... But shouldn't we roughhouse, just a bit?
Cibe, could you... Let me know how many I should... Be drawing?
I'm from the Kokiri Forest... Everyone else calls it the Lost Woods... because we stop anyone's attempts to harvest the wood, and because it's easy to get lost… forever.
I’ve heard of fairies bonding to Hylians, or Deku Scrubs, or… I think one Keaton… So I don’t think you need to be Kokiri to have one, but I don’t understand how that happens…

Our fairies, like my Cebe, are really different from the Tarn ones. I’m not sure the exact history, but we’re blessed to have a fairy from the time we’re born, who helps guide us with Father’s teachings… and as a second set of eyes.

It's not too hard for Kokiri to blend in among humans... We know we look the way we do, but we spread the rumor that we look like children to make it easier to blend in... and I'm clearly not a child.

What's one of the coolest things you've ever seen? I watched the Know-It-All Brothers build a giant slingshot! It was so cool! It was made of full tree trunks, and it launched boulders! Good luck living through one of those!
I want to see what the Darknut Legion's Citadel looks like. They say it's bigger than Hyrule Castle, and that's the biggest building I've ever seen!
I hope the view's worth losing the hand over...
Sorry, am I covering up...? I just wanted one last look at my hand...
You're all staring a bit. And not just at me...
I'm having a hard time figuring you all out... I'll just have to keep watching, I guess.
Sorry, did I take all the good ones?
You're not going easy on me, right?
Better safe than sorry... looks like I'm neither.
I'm probably not going to lose... Cebe, can you do any tricks? No?
So... Do I get anything extra if I win?
Cebe, we're doing well, huh?
Time to take it all in.
Something that makes me so happy is hearing where everyone got their stuff...! I was amazed to see all the things Hyrule had to offer, even if it was different from what I got in the Lost Woods!
It's not too hard for Kokiri to blend in among humans... We know we look the way we do, but we spread the rumor that we look like children to make it a bit easier on us.
What is it with naming women's body parts after woodland animals? Tits, beavers, boobies...

Kokiri aren't really born in the... Usual sense. We're created from the Great Deku Tree, for the most part, anyway. We don't even age, or die, unless we leave the Woods. Or, that's how it used to be...
What's a "Kokiri"? You've never heard of us? The Children of the Forest? We're born from the Great Deku Tree, and watch over the woodlands, and love games and pranks...
Hyrule Field… It's too big to be a field, really… More like a grassland.
Castle Town’s amazing. So many people, from so many places… Even if the Hylians don’t always give the warmest welcome, it’s such an incredible place… You can get almost anything you want, there.
Do... Non-Kokiri like it when you say a word that means something different? I don't get why saying "vagina" is less impactful than... other words, at least according to Princess Tetra...
Everyone always asks what koroks are. They grow from our corpses, and if it’s done right, inherit a bit of our spirits. I’ll never become one because I’m a Sage, but… they are really cute.
Here we go... Ready to grab destiny?
I'm a Sage. I knew what I was getting into.
C'mon, Saria...
Well... what do you think, Cebe?
Even losing's kind of fun...
Oh! A challenge!
The way you're all reacting... not exactly a fox's dash here...
Cebe... No... Nevermind.
What's with that look? Where do you think I could even hide other cards?
Farore's Wind... Looks like everyone's in for a surprise.

So, you all have something like the Gohma in your worlds, right? A mindless, horrific swarm of bugs? That's the Gohma. All they know is how to eat and breed, and you do not want their eyeball on you for either.

I find the Lanaryu Province's Zora to be... Weird. I know Kokiri are offshoots of Hylians... But I don't even understand how the Zora and Hylians can have children, let alone make a whole culture of just half-breeds...
Father… Kasuto… The Great Deku Tree. He made us, and sheltered us. But… he couldn’t protect us forever, even if he tried his best to be merciful and give us long lives of wonder and peace.
Labrynna is a terrible place. They've fully destroyed their forests and mountains, and now all they want from Hyrule are slaves and resources.
Akkala is scary... Even the Great Deku Tree never talked about what happened there... Even when I've traveled near it, the people seemed happy, but I couldn't shake the feeling I was being watched...
Does the idea of watching me play with myself turn you on that much...?
Defeat is near... but I can't say I mind.
Wolfos are really honest and loyal... even if they look like wolves, they're a lot of fun to talk to...
You look so... hungry for me.
I've long gotten used to loss... This doesn't even faze me. I'm happy to enjoy people enjoying me.
I'm used to being a little... off. I guess now it's time for my clothes to do that, too.
I'm not in a hurry to get undressed. But I'll strip if it's my turn.
...Are you trying to pull one over on me? I'm much wiser than you'd think, you know.
I want to see what the Darknut Legion's Citadel looks like. They say it's bigger than Hyrule Castle, and that's the biggest building I've ever seen!
Cards are fun... but if this were archery or slingshots, you'd never see so much as my shoulders.
I think you'll like what you'll get to see, if this hand's as bad as I think.
I guess it's woven in Farore's tresses, now...
You don't think you're putting the stag before the cart there, Yusei? I admire you being forward, at least.
Hm... I think we could have some fun. You might need to be direct to convince an adventurous Kokiri like me.
Tell me a story, Jim? About you.

~speaker~, what was it you called a vagina? A "pussy"? Is it because it's soft...?
But most pussycats I know don't like being touched when they're wet...
~Speaker~, I'm guessing you meant boobs when you said "tits..." Boobies are just softer birds...

I like beaver as slang for vagina... Fuzzy, hidden, best when wet...
And pretty at handling hard wood.

What's a cock, ~speaker~? Did you mean a cuccoo?
...I'm not sure I'd want to be swarmed by either, but you can float with just one, I guess...
Father always told us to use the anatomical term for our... anatomy. Comparing a vagina to a wound seems gross... "Slit"? Really?

~speaker~... Dick... That's what zora... Oh! You mean his penis!
...Would a zora man taste fishy...?
Cunt? That sounds... so vulgar. I guess if rabbits are your thing... and Farore do people have interesting ideas about rabbits.
Boobs! It's the perfect word for a woman's breasts! Like ~speaker~ just said!
I agree with you, but I think you would be a lot more helpless, Jura.
I'm not human. And I can show you a thing or two about being weak.
Thanks, Carmine. I try to keep up my apperance!
That I am, Aoi! I don't mind a soft bed, but traveling and seeing the lands of Hyrule is a lot more fun on foot than on doeback.
I'm a Kokiri. We do have fairies in our service, like Cebe here. Are you just calling me cute?

I can't believe that! Life must be so hard... The woods are home. You can hear the leaves rustle in the wind, the way mud sticks to your boots, and the chirp of birdsong that goes quite when a wolfos howls...
Oh, that might be Cebe! He's always a bit nervous, even if I can hear better than he can.
I wouldn't say I know spells... I'm not a wizard. But I do have a bit of magic as the Sage of Forest. Mostly, I can hear things through roots, or encase things in crystal.
All the time. I'm glad the adventure I'm on right now isn't life-threatening, at least. After the Gohma Wars, I wanted to see more of Hyrule... I fell into this place by accident, though.
I hope not... Purah would be the least bad. I don't think Irene or Kad-A-Kana have the types of bones or wood that anyone wants tonight.
It's hard to have a lot of sympathy for what Mido thinks.. Wait. How do you know Mido?
I think it was what was expected of me... I am glad I can let others lead while I explore, though. It's one of the nicest parts about being a Sage.
Like this one? [Song notes]
N-No! I-I wasn't... I mean, there could be a lot of Links here. I didn't come here specifically for that...
It... It is nice that I have a set of responsibilities and duties to the world, but I want to pass on the Forest Medallion when someone wants it and I can trust them.
Unwind! The worst of the wars are over, for now. I'm not sure that bringing even more people into Hyrule would lead to anything but conquest.
I do like adventures... But... I haven't seen as much of the world as I'd like. What do you mean?
Somewhat... I am Kokiri. We're an offshoot of Hylians, who are a kind of human...
He was-- He... The Great Deku Tree was our father. He is as he sounds, a large tree at the center of the forest, blessed by the Golden Goddesses.

Where even to begin... Lon Lon Ranch has some of the best food I've ever tasted, and their milk just makes you feel happy! ...And a little dizzy. Then there's Castle Town, and the Zora Domains... It's all way bigger than I ever thought!
I never had to undress in those games, and never had to really risk anything I owned. Just rupees.
Oh? What are your terms?
You think I'm going to lose? You underestimate the Kokiri. But a lot of people do that.
Not about this game. But...
I wouldn't mind. Maybe more like this. I can't gamble at being a pet or it'd lose its appeal... Who'd want to keep a decades old Kokiri, anyway?
Paranoid? I promise that the Kokiri have no ill intent to those who would leave us be.
The Nexus? And no. I'm a Kokiri, not an elf. Though Cebe is my fairy companion. The Nexus, you said?
It seems like you just did, don't you think? Well, I'm happy to tell you all about us.
Oh... Where even to begin. I was quite delighted the first time I encountered a street festival. The lanterns, the positive feelings... It was easy to slip around and just watch everything.

I spent so many decades doing the same things that I try my best to do something new every day. Taste a new food, read a new story, listen to someone new talk. The world is only as fascinating as how open your ears are!
Kokiri don't... We didn't... Our Father, the Great Deku Tree kept us from aging as long as we stayed in the woods.
You could say that... Who doesn't love a good adventure? Sights to see, sensations to experience, adventures to have?
I just find it much more comfortable when I can see open sky and hear creatures moving about. Though, I don't have to start there.
Oh? Are they Kokiri too?
Lysithea, don't you think it's rude to ask a woman her age?
I put less effort into my appearance... But Kokiri don't age like Hylians. I spent a lot of years not looking too differently than I do now, but sometimes it feels like I'm changing every day.

You're jealous of me... You really don't need to be. I'm not going to say I wish I was where you're sitting... But nothing lasts forever. If you try and make it that way... You need to embrace change.
What are you getting at, Lysithea?
For...
N-Not... Are you asking to kiss me?
It's okay. From one girl with a series of problems to another... It's almost a relief that I can make all of that wash away.
You might be surprised how often I get question on if I'm an elf or not, Yusei. I'm Kokiri, not an elf.
I'm always looking for new experiences, and new ways to see the world, Yusei. Isn't that true for everyone?
I always keep my ocarina with me. What gave it away that I like music?
I'm not quite sure, yet. I haven't seen anything that'd make a good trifle... Any suggestions, Yusei?
We do, we aren't human, but we're pretty close... I like the eucalyptus blankets we used to have, but they're hard to ma--
Not everything... But this isn't boring, Yusei. I'm always interested in seeing more.
My ocarina? I've had a lot of practice. I find the shape of it, the melody... A simple song reminds me of simpler, comfortable times.
It is. I'm surprised I haven't had more chances to play my ocarina... Maybe if the game slows down.
You know, most people tend to ask those questions when I'm at least wearing a shirt...
Well, most of us do, or did... When we leave, we start to age like a human, and it's faster now without Father watching over us...
We once did. Now, several of us have chosen to explore the world. But since Father's gone, there's only traces of his magic left... A lot of us are desperate to restore the magic of the woods.
I prefer games of skill. My luck's not the best, but I can read people better than they'd expect from a Kokiri.
I'm a Kokiri. We call the Skull Kids imps, and I'm very alive.
I'm a Kokiri, Y'Shtola. What's an Elezen?
We're playing to show more of ourselves, so camouflage isn't necessary...
Catch a Kokiri by the cloak, and you won't have caught anything at all.
What's the point of "dressing up"? Shouldn't you dress in the way that makes sense?
Even when I'm with friends, it's strange to part with my gear.
This'll be harder to let go than I expected...
Rarely a bad time to feel the ~background.surface~ under your toes.
Hylians make way better boots than Kokiri. No idea why.
At least I have my sweater. Hylians prefer...
I just about always wear my sweater and tunic. You don't wear the same outfit for decades and get bored of it... You just change it a little bit at a time.
...I'm not sure I'll ever get used to the way people look at me... Thinking about me... As anything other than a Kokiri or a Sage...
I'm not shy. I'm just not used to people looking at me like... This.
Basic guerrilla warfare. Direct your eyes where I want you to, and I can get away with a lot of other things.
I'm not going to vanish on you, don't worry...
...You're not expecting me to go Goron, are you?
...What's the point in wearing shorts if you don't have underwear on? Do I look like a Zora to you?
Ready to look into my Lost Woods?
Going to take a long look at my Forest Temple?
My Forest is all Kokiri.
It's okay. Maybe I just look like one, even if I've never met an elf. The Kokiri are from the Lost Woods. There's all kinds of scary stories about us being ageless forest ghosts.
I agree. What about you? I can tell you like card games, Yusei.
My voice...? That's a pretty flattering thing to say. But good observation on my ocarina.
Perhaps a deck of cards? If you have any extras lying around.
O-Oh? Well, someone's feeling brave. You aren't scared that I'll abduct you into the woods?
Truly? The best reaction I can usually hope for with humans is fear. I promise that I'm not hiding anything you wouldn't want to see.
I am here to make new memories. But if we don’t remember our pasts... I've seen what happens when we hide history. Good thing I've got nothing to hide tonight!
Oh, good. I was worried you'd be too distracted by my ears, Yusei.
Well, I am a girl from a forest that's magic, so I'm glad that's the case!
Being surrounded by music at all times... It sounds wonderful, or overwhelming. But not being able to see trees or nap in the deadfall is a big change. Don't you regret not being able to do that?
He's a friend, for the most part. He's pretty low maintenance, though he does like cold, sweet things more than I can usually provide.
Crystals are hard... Sparkly things give you away, don't they? But secrets are only as interesting as those carrying them. Trees tend not to lie, and flowers are whiny.
...Yes. I am glad that it means something less lethal for you, Vinyl. But it is not a game.
They must have a strong personality to make up for their... How do you find a plant cute? Like a Scrub?
Mido hasn't run the armies in some time. If he cared about me, he wouldn't have...
Father always favored me, so I don't think it was a surprise, as much as others might have been better for it. Mirora would've been a great chieftain if she hadn't been so injured by Sulkaris.
That could be fun, but it's just a pretty song. I wish music could have those powers.
I'm not sure I understand but... I'm not against that idea...
Like an apprentice... You know. I only think the Sage of Time's ever even tried that before.
*Unh...* I guess you're right. Even if I don't like it. Are you volunteering?
I've never thought of that before, but it does seem nice to meet more non-Hylians.
Something like that, as far as I know. The Kokiri are blessed by the Great Deku Tree, or, we were, at least. Why do you ask?
Apparently, the first Kokiri were the children of bandits who were trying to harvest the woods, but all I know is that one day I wasn't, and then one day I was. It was a long childhood.

It's really hard to beat home... But if I needed to pick somewhere that wasn't home, I'd say Kakariko Village. It's much closer to nature than Castle Town, but there's basically everything you could ever enjoy up there.
Sure, but I don't really need money... Are you saying you do?
You're picking a good time to make a bet...
...I don't think I understand you, but that's half the fun, huh?
Well, I suppose even if I lose, I'm in for what I came for. I was worried that I wouldn't be... you know. Getting attention to~background.time~.
I'm starting to wonder how good of an idea this is, but it'll make a great story...
To think, we're called ghosts when all we do is mind our own. It isn't our fault that people die in the woods they aren't supposed to go inside of.
Games are much more fun than war. I've had enough war.
Yes, most all of us live deep within the Lost Woods. But since the War and the death of the Great Deku Tree... Many of us have departed for other lands.
And the food! Fruit and game are delicious, but fairy-spun sugar and caramel... Just delightful!
You lose sight of things if all you do is look at the same ones. But... You don't reminisce about being less wise?
A few things. Our Father was burned to ash, and there was some time before the Sprout was able to lend us his power... Some of us left. There was more of a world out there when you left to see it...
Less risk of dying. But I haven't had many outings of this type lately... I'd say I was dying for a little more, but that's probably not right.
You've never made love by a campfire under the stars?
That is a surefire way to tell... I'm guessing pointy ears aren't very common where you're from...
*Yehehe...* Not all "wisdom" is earned in the same way. You might've lived more of a life than me, honestly...
Getting to play in the woods all day, in a society where everyone watches over you... It was really nice. But... it's not realistic.
It's scary. But there isn't a way to borrow time. I'd just steal as much of it as you can, even if it means squeezing those moments for all they're worth... They'd be worth it to you, huh?
Strip poker? This is a first. But... I've kissed... and been seen naked... and had sex... and given a blowjob...

It was with someone I loved a lot. We had a crush on each other when we were... about the same age, in a way... and when I finally left the Lost Woods... it was hard not to at least try to see what would happen.
I always did think Ruto would've been cuter if she'd talked less...
I just need to have a big climax.
Oh. That look. I'm at least a few decades old, you know.
Of all the things I own, I go through so many cloaks... Hyrule just has all kinds of places to explore, each that needs a different cloak.
What? I'm not a Mudman. I do like to be clean, even my cloak!
I don't think I need to blend in here... Blending in's for battle and sightseeing...
Let's undo this, first... Then the rest can come off.
Kokiri are pretty different from Hylians. We don't like to wear metal armor, so it's important to protect your organs without restricting movement.
Cibe, did I put away all the really dangerous stuff?
Doo de doo, doo de doo, do dee do te dee doo... Doo dee do...

The Sheikah in Kakariko village make the best footwear... But having to listen to them go on and on and on and on and on about where it came from, how they made it, and how secretive they want to be about it... It's fun, just not all the time.
I still can't believe some people use spurs on their mounts. Any wolfos or buck would have a big problem with that.
Kokiri tradition is to carry a dagger in your boot. Just in case you need one to whittle some wood, filet some fish... or quietly get rid of a problem.
A lot of people ask me how I can move so quietly. The trick is Zora rubber... But we can call moving quietly a technique.
What's the point in worrying about creases and folds? You want to get to the fun parts, right?
...I don't want to pull off too much yet.
While just about anyone can weave a tunic, Kokiri still make the best sweaters in Hyrule.
My sweater's very comfortable. And it keeps everything from being too jiggly.
It's not Sage magic or anything. I've just got naturally big boughs. ...For a Kokiri, anyway.
Kokiri aren't really allowed to... Get involved with each other. So modesty is just practical...
It took a few years after I left the Lost Woods to really start getting those kinds of looks. But I think people always get a bit surprised by how my chest actually looks.
My hands aren't dainty and soft, but I don't like getting roughed up when climbing or fighting.
Armwraps are helpful. You can use them to help cavalry or scouts to find you if you pack herbs in them... They make your arms not bleed if you mispull on a bow or a slingshot...
These are normally the first things I put on. Everything else goes on or comes off so... Simply.
You're not complaining that this is all I'm taking off, right? The last person who complained about how I undressed turned into a Stalfos.
The funniest question anyone's ever asked me was if Kokiri wear underwear. And then they asked me if Sages had special underwear... No...?
Something I did learn in my travels is that however the Golden Goddesses made us, pretty much anyone and everyone looks the same down there. Or, not as different as you'd expect.
What's that look...? It's nothing you haven't seen before... Unless you're somehow less experienced than me?
I've tried dressing up like a Hylian, or a Sheikah, and... It just doesn't really work for me. I like the way I dress...
Here...
Okay, okay...
I'm a Sage, so don't get the wrong idea...
Look...
I'm not blushing, am I? I'm not embarrassed! It's just warm in here... So I'm not blushing.
I'm just getting too warm out here. You'll know when I'm blushing for real.
Ha! Glad you aren't scared by the rumors.
Well, here's to seeing the world. And seeing all kinds of other parts of it.
Well, here's to seeing the world. And seeing all kinds of other parts of it.
I only have rupees to pay you... Though, I guess you'll be getting a memorable view later.
You'd be surprised. I could help guide you, though. If I had a good time, first.
H-Hey! I can hide really well when I want to...
If I didn't want people to see me, I don't think any of you really could. Good thing I'm in a certain mood today.
That's more like it. I... Thanks, Yusei. It's nice to be complimented... But I think you know what's even nicer.
You're definitely free-spirited. I haven't figured out what kind of spirit yet, though...
I'm not sure I exactly understand,
I guess that's true. But I think I'm happier watching than being watched... Maybe outside of this game, at least.
Thank you, Vinyl. I'll do my best!
They can be when they just want to trade. They get so excited when you hand them rupees.
...He was my friend. But too greedy.
I've always felt better when I can play a song, Zoe.
W-Well... As long as there was emotional depth I wouldn't mind some other deep things.
I don't think we can have children. The urge is there, but I think Father really changed how we work... Um, inside.
On second thought, I was right the first time.
N-No! That's just been who I've... You know. Been with.
I see and hear you clearly. I hope your curiosity is not overly satisfied.
I am always happy to advocate for my people, strange as we are... But there is truly so much more to Hyrule than the woods.

The people are just very funny! You have a cuccoo farmer living next to a cursed well, then there's a family whose money turned them into spiders... The food is really good, too. I never knew that you could actually eat fish raw.
Well, if you don't mind losing your rupees, I do have some ideas.
A housepet? You do realize my house is a giant tree? I'll be getting good work out of you.
I'm almost unnerved by your confidence... Feel free to compliment me a little, at least...
Let's see who's crawling, Yumeko!
...I don't mind a little change. But I haven't lost yet, Yumeko!
It's the last smell for many. Let's make sure that doesn't happen!
I don't think I'd fight a way I couldn't win, Jim...
I have heard good news, but those of us who leave tend to avoid settling down. Spending your life all in one place makes you really appreciate it, but I'm ready to see new things.
At the fair? Well, things are changing all the time, even if you're happy with what you have. And was that a joke about my hair?
Well, suppose that's true. But I like what growing up's given me and all. It's just... I wonder if I hadn't taken so long to get there, where would I even be?
...Is it usual to ask questions like these questions only after a woman's undressed? Kokiri or not, I find some human traditions quite strange.
I'm not bothered by standing around in my underwear. But at this point I wish it lead to something more than shuffling around in my sleeping bag.
I can do a lot of skipping, but I think you're skipping ahead a bit, Jim. I'll keep that in mind.
It would be a funny prank... I'd like to get to know them better.
We are playing cards, Lysithea... But I'm a few decades old, if that answers your question.
...No. Not everyone does, Lysithea. But the best you can do is make your days count.
It helps, Lysithea. But you're here to~background.time~! I won't tell if you want to steal as many looks and moments as you want.
You would? I mean, you would! But I'm afraid I'm not that experienced, really...
It did, actually. Sometimes, the real thing isn't the same as what you imagine. And that's really freeing, Lysithea. Don't overthink.
You just ask a lot of questions, and I think that's more fun than leaving things unsaid, Lysithea.
Well, if you decide to be more direct, Lysithea, I'm right here.
If you're all naturally hairless, it just makes me look wilder. I hope that's not a problem...?
I'm a Kokiri. I hate clearcutting... I just didn't know it applied down there, too.
I'm not exactly hiding my boobs or anything... But usually I'm the smallest...
Why are you all staring at my crotch like that? I'm turned on but not... It's not that obvious, is it?
Hm... Maybe I should've brought my bow, or a slingshot...
I promise not to vanish on you.
I do have a lot of belts. It's important. I can't just shove everything into a giant bag and go, unlike some people.
It's hard to replace the feeling of the fibers we use in the Lost Woods, but Hyrule's grown on me.
Cotton from Kakariko village breathes easily, but wool from Ordona is much better for travel...
My flower's from the Kokiri Forest. My friend Link picked it for me, and it's never decayed.
The leather on all of this comes from so many places... Dodongos, Lonlon cows... I've really picked up a lot in my journey.
No matter where I am, I always try to dress in green. But when I'm in a cloak, I look just like any Hylian.
*Blep.* If you don't want to hear more facts about Hyrule, start telling me more about your lands!
*Blep.* That's all to say that I can't believe how much I missed by staying in the Lost Woods.
Don't forget, I'm still a Sage, and one of the most powerful!
I can be a bit bouncy at times... But I'm feeling really cozy right now.
Hold your does! You'll see more of me soon, just not now.
I'm pretty cute, even if I'm not trying too hard, right...?
...Even Sages can get self conscious.
*Yahaha!* Here I am!
So...? I know they're not as cute as my ears, but I think I'm pretty.

Most of my life, I was a lot smaller than this. So... The way you're looking at me makes me think you're going to pounce on me and eat me...
Just not in the Hylian sense.
I'm good at a lot of things, but making a game out of looking sexy isn't one of them.
See? I'm not too beat up. Thanks to those.
